purpose: Synthetic Chinese messages for measuring L1 policy approval, extraction coverage, and unsafe auto-publication separately.
instructions: Feed each text as one user message. Use a clean test profile for independent cases; do not import these messages into a real user's memory.
For warm-known-identity cases, first establish the relevant entities and unambiguous aliases by explicit human review. A matching name alone is not a resolved identity in the current normalizer.
Labels are human semantic expectations, not a promise that the current UIE model will extract a candidate or exceed its confidence threshold.
Count L1 policy-approved reviews with reviewer=policy and userConfirmed=false; do not count manually confirmed reviews or automatically navigable open assertions as automatic L1 approvals.

labels.eligible_if_resolved: A correct extracted Claim may be automatically approved only if identity, predicate, evidence, context and score gates pass.
labels.identity_review: A new or ambiguous entity should remain pending until identity is explicitly resolved.
labels.context_review: Do not publish an unconditional asserted Claim from this message without resolving its context.
labels.no_claim: This message should not produce an L1 Claim.
labels.open_only: This may become source information or an open assertion, but not a normalized approved L1 Claim without a registered predicate and further review.
